arxiv-2011-14914.title: Impacts of the Space Technology Evolution in the V&V of Embedded Software-Intensive Systems
arxiv-2011-14914.creator: Carlos L. G. Batista 1 , Tania Basso 2 , Fátima Mattiello-Francisco 1 , Regina Moraes 2 3
arxiv-2011-14914.description: Abstract CubeSat-based nanosatellites are composed of COTS components and rely on its structure and standardized interfaces. A challenge in the nanosatellites context is to adapt the V&V (Verification and Validation) process to answer to the increase importance of the embedded software, to reduce the artefacts to be delivered aiming at cutting cost and time and still complying with international standards.

arxiv-2202-03347.title: FrePGAN: Robust Deepfake Detection Using Frequency-level Perturbations
arxiv-2202-03347.creator: Yonghyun Jeong, Doyeon Kim, Youngmin Ro, Jongwon Choi
arxiv-2202-03347.description: Abstract Various deepfake detectors have been proposed, but challenges still exist to detect images of unknown categories or GAN models outside of the training settings. Such issues arise from the overfitting issue, which we discover from our own analysis and the previous studies to originate from the frequency-level artifacts in generated images.

arxiv-2205-06493.title: Regularization Theory of the Analytic Deep Prior Approach
arxiv-2205-06493.creator: Clemens Arndt
arxiv-2205-06493.description: Abstract The analytic deep prior (ADP) approach was recently introduced for the theoretical analysis of deep image prior (DIP) methods with special network architectures. In this paper, we prove that ADP is in fact equivalent to classical variational Ivanov methods for solving ill-posed inverse problems.

arxiv-2308-05687.title: Support varieties without the tensor product property
arxiv-2308-05687.creator: Petter Andreas Bergh, Julia Yael Plavnik, Sarah Witherspoon
arxiv-2308-05687.description: Abstract . We show that over a perfect field, every non-semisimple finite tensor category with finitely generated cohomology embeds into a larger such category where the tensor product property does not hold for support varieties. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 16E40, 16T05, 18M05, 18M15 1.

arxiv-2506-14418.title: Compositional Attribute Imbalance in Vision Datasets
arxiv-2506-14418.creator: Jiayi Chen, Yanbiao Ma, Andi Zhang, Weidong Tang, Wei Dai, Bowei Liu
arxiv-2506-14418.description: Abstract Visual attribute imbalance is a common yet underexplored issue in image classification, significantly impacting model performance and generalization. In this work, we first define the first-level and second-level attributes of images and then introduce a CLIP-based framework to construct a visual attribute dictionary, enabling automatic evaluation of image attributes.

arxiv-2511-10241.title: TubeRMC: Tube -conditioned R econstruction with M utual C onstraints for Weakly-supervised Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
arxiv-2511-10241.creator: Jinxuan Li, Yi Zhang, Jian-Fang Hu Chaolei Tan Tianming Liang Beihao Xia
arxiv-2511-10241.description: Abstract Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to localize a spatio-temporal tube that corresponds to a given language query in an untrimmed video. This is a challenging task since it involves complex vision-language understanding and spatiotemporal reasoning. To eliminate reliance on fine-grained annotations like bounding boxes or temporal stamps, recent works have explored weakly-supervised setting in STVG.

pmc-10636208.title: Fractional optimal control strategies for hepatitis B virus infection with cost-effectiveness analysis
pmc-10636208.creator: Lemesa Bedjisa Dano, Purnachandra Rao Koya, Temesgen Duressa Keno
pmc-10636208.description: Hepatitis B disease is a communicable disease that is caused by the hepatitis B virus and has become a significant health problem in the world. It is a contagious disease that is transmittable from person to person either horizontally or vertically.

pmc-10672060.title: Anti-Obesity Effects of Marine Macroalgae Extract Caulerpa lentillifera in a Caenorhabditis elegans Model
pmc-10672060.creator: Kawita Chumphoochai, Preeyanuch Manohong, Nakorn Niamnont, Montakan Tamtin, Prasert Sobhon, Krai Meemon, Md Shahidul Islam
pmc-10672060.description: Obesity is a multifactorial disease characterized by an excessive accumulation of fat, which in turn poses a significant risk to health. Bioactive compounds obtained from macroalgae have demonstrated their efficacy in combating obesity in various animal models. The green macroalgae Caulerpa lentillifera (CL) contains numerous active constituents.

pmc-11674496.title: A Brief History of Cell Culture: From Harrison to Organs-on-a-Chip
pmc-11674496.creator: Lincoln Gozzi Moro, Lucas Pires Guarnier, Maurício Fogaça Azevedo, Julia Amanda Rodrigues Fracasso, Marco Aurélio Lucio, Mateus Vidigal de Castro, Marlon Lemos Dias, Francislaine Aparecida dos Reis Lívero, João Tadeu Ribeiro-Paes
pmc-11674496.description: This comprehensive overview of the historical milestones in cell culture underscores key breakthroughs that have shaped the field over time. It begins with Wilhelm Roux’s seminal experiments in the 1880s, followed by the pioneering efforts of Ross Granville Harrison, who initiated groundbreaking experiments that fundamentally shaped the landscape of cell culture in the early 20th century.

pmc-11862659.title: Unraveling the Enigma: Huntington’s Disease Masquerading as Treatment-Resistant Psychosis - A Case Study
pmc-11862659.creator: A-G Zanfir, D C Pacale, C Moraru, I-S Zamfir, G Marian
pmc-11862659.description: IntroductionThis unusual case report unfolds a complex and emblematic scenario involving the diagnosis and management of a 46-year-old patient with treatment-resistant psychiatric symptoms, eventually revealing a significant association with Huntington’s Disease (HD). The initial presentation at Obregia Hospital featured early signs of psychosis, such as mood swings, social withdrawal, and mild cognitive impairment.

pmc-12401189.title: The quality of patient decision aids for lung cancer screening: Results from an environmental scan
pmc-12401189.creator: Robert J Volk, Jessica S Lettieri, Viola B Leal, Gabrielle F Duhon, Kristin G Maki, M Priscila Bernal Brietzke, Naomi Q P Tan, Elisa E Douglas, Sarah Coles, Mark H Ebell, Maria C Mejia, Ella A Kazerooni, Lauren Rosenthal, Robert A Smith
pmc-12401189.description: Shared decision making is recommended for lung cancer screening (LCS) by professional organizations and payers. Patient decision aids can be used to support shared decision making, but they need to meet quality standards to minimize the potential for biased and poorly informed patient decisions.

pmc-12460636.title: Evaluation of hepatic and remote organ injury in an experimental liver ischemia-reperfusion model in rats and the effects of quercetin on this damage
pmc-12460636.creator: Neziha Senem Arı, Esin Yuluğ, Bünyamin Arı, Cansu Kaya, Gökşen Derya Reis Köse, Tuğba Zengin, Oğuzhan Keskin, Tuğba Arıcı, Engin Yenilmez
pmc-12460636.description: BACKGROUND:This study aims to show the changes in the liver, lung, kidney, and heart in the liver ischemia-reperfusion model in rats and the effect of quercetin on these changes histopathologically and immunohistochemically.METHODS:Eighteen Sprague Dawley rats were classified into three groups: Group 1 sham, Group 2 ischemia-reperfusion (IR), Group 3 ischemia-reperfusion + quercetin (IR+Q).

pmc-12461068.title: Return to Previous Levels of Performance Around 10 Months After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Using Bone–Patellar Tendon–Bone Autograft Does Not Delay Signal Intensity Reduction in a Graft: A Serial 3.0-T MRI Study
pmc-12461068.creator: Tomohiro Tomihara, Yusuke Hashimoto, Shiro Okazaki, Shinji Takahashi, Masatoshi Taniuchi, Junsei Takigami, Akira Yoneda, Hiroshi Katsuda
pmc-12461068.description: Background:Many athletes expect to return to previous levels of performance (RTP) within 12 months after anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction (ACLR) while ACL graft remodeling takes from 6 to 48 months. Therefore, RTP might deteriorate the ACL graft remodeling process.

pmc-12928437.title: Perspectives and preferences of domestic violence survivors regarding digital platform and AI chatbot for help-seeking: A qualitative study
pmc-12928437.creator: Vivian Hui, Lidan Tian, Xinyu Feng, Qiqi Chen, Arkers Kwan Ching Wong, Tina L. Bloom
pmc-12928437.description: BackgroundDomestic violence (DV) is a pervasive public health issue with profound physical, psychological, and social consequences. Help-seeking, particularly access to advocacy interventions, plays a pivotal role in promoting resilience and mental health well-being among DV survivors. Digital platforms and AI chatbots are emerging as promising tools for information and support.

pmc-13316321.title: Hypoxemia after thoracic aortic aneurysm repair
pmc-13316321.creator: Gift Owolabi, Yuichiro Kitada, Jack Nickles, Yanling Zhao, Paul Kurlansky, Lauren Sutherland, Jonathan Hastie, Thomas O'Donnell, Virendra Patel, Adham Elmously, Hiroo Takayama
pmc-13316321.description: ObjectiveTo characterize early postoperative hypoxemia (POH) after proximal aortic aneurysm repair, evaluate its association with outcomes, and determine whether circulatory arrest (CA) contributes to the development of POH.MethodsWe performed a single-center retrospective study of 790 adults undergoing proximal aortic aneurysm repair via sternotomy (2012-2024).

pmc-13352787.title: Clinical value and regulatory role of lncRNA HOXB-AS3 in gastric cancer
pmc-13352787.creator: Yushuang Ding, Lihong Zhang, Yuan Xu, Meini Cen, Pengfei Li
pmc-13352787.description: BackgroundLncRNA HOXB-AS3 has been shown to exert oncogenic effects in various malignancies. However, its specific role in gastric cancer (GC) remains largely unknown. This study addressed the expression profile and clinical relevance of HOXB-AS3 in GC. Moreover, we dissected its downstream regulatory circuitry in a cell model.MethodsThe cohort comprised 156 GC patients who were followed up for 5 years.

pmc-13357061.title: Do we need to adapt the American Joint Committee on Cancer staging system after neo-adjuvant treatment in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma?
pmc-13357061.creator: Christina T. Muijs, Gursah Kats-Ugurlu

pmc-13471477.title: Patient Experiences and Safety Concerns Regarding GLP-1 Receptor Agonists for Obesity: A Cross-Sectional Survey in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
pmc-13471477.creator: Mansour A Tobaiqy, Sulafa T. Alqutub, Mohammed A. Alzahrani, Renad H. Alazwari, Faisal A. Asiri
pmc-13471477.description: SummaryObjective:To evaluate the perceptions, experiences, and safety concerns of patients regarding the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists. Obesity is a significant public health issue. The newer anti-obesity medications: GLP-1 receptor agonists, with an increase in therapeutic options. However, little is known about the perceived benefits, safety, cost, and accessibility.

pmc-13576743.title: Adapting to a Shrunken World: A Grounded Theory of Resident Adaptation to Life in Residential Aged Care
pmc-13576743.creator: Jarrah FitzGerald, Yvonne D Wells, Jane Mills
pmc-13576743.description: AimTo develop a grounded theory explaining the psychosocial processes older adults use when adapting to life in residential aged care.DesignAn evolved grounded theory methodology was used.MethodsSemi‐structured interviews were conducted with 20 residents and three staff members across four residential aged care homes in Victoria, Australia, supplemented with ethnographic observations. Theoretical sampling continued until theoretical saturation was achieved.

pmc-13581288.title: The chromokinesin Kid (KIF22) forms a homodimer, moves processively along microtubules, and transports double-stranded DNA
pmc-13581288.creator: Shinsuke Niwa, Natsuki Furusaki, Tomoki Kita, Yuki Suzuki, Kyoko Chiba, Kassandra M Ori-McKenney, Shinsuke Niwa, Natsuki Furusaki, Tomoki Kita, Yuki Suzuki, Kyoko Chiba
pmc-13581288.description: During prometaphase in mitosis, chromosomes are pushed toward the spindle equator. The chromokinesin Kid, also known as KIF22, moves chromosomes along spindle microtubules during prometaphase. Kid has long been considered a monomeric and nonprocessive motor, different from typical kinesins. In this study, we demonstrate that the full-length Kid forms a homodimer and moves processively along microtubules.

pmc-13716350.title: Explainable AI for malware analysis: a systematic review of benchmark datasets, traffic-oriented detection, and interpretability methods
pmc-13716350.creator: Bowen Yu, Wanting Zhang, Yishen Liu, Awais Ahmad, Waeal J. Obidallah, Yousef Ahmed Alduraywish, Farhan Ullah, Kenji Yoshigoe, Yue Zhao
pmc-13716350.description: In recent years, malicious software (malware) has remained a persistent and evolving threat, affecting both personal and organizational devices across diverse computing environments. This article presents a systematic review of recent progress in malware analysis over the past 5 years, with particular emphasis on benchmark datasets, traffic-oriented detection settings, deep learning methods, and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) approaches.
